about:
Freeze the cell-class false cases of the skeptic's set (mvp22/skeptic) and the record checker's set
(mvp23/record_check, cases_v2) into the repo (eval/brain_cells_extra.json), each with the tool results it is checked
on (made-up library only), the verifier's turn, its class and what cells mode does with it today; plus a few
framing-class and true controls. tests/test_brain_cells.py reads it. mvp25: N27's kept_cells re-pinned (False) after the cells rules of DESIGN 24.4.
